label: TP
reason: The user-controlled input from request.getParameterMap() flows through the doSomething method and is directly concatenated into a system command via cmd + bar, creating a command injection vulnerability where arbitrary OS commands can be executed based on user input.

evidence.note: User input from parameter map is read and passed through doSomething(), which returns param unmodified, then used in exec() call
The vulnerable sink uses user-controlled param in cmd + bar to construct a shell command
